geometry.quote: PA852 b.911 Access point for ECN3 underground cavern

method: OpenStreetMap way 44413082 (name 911) used verbatim. The North Area Consolidation page lists "PA852 b.911 Access point for ECN3 underground cavern" and "BX83 b.918 Counting rooms for ECN3 experimental cavern", and MapCERN lists building 911 as BAA85. The cavern itself (the page calls it "Underground Experimental Cavern 3 (900)", 1887 m2) is underground and its outline is not published; these surface buildings mark where it is served.
name: ECN3 access building (building 911, PA852)

summary.plain: The surface access building to the underground experimental cavern ECN3 of the CERN North Area, which housed NA48 and houses NA62.
